name: decision-write-integrity
description: Process guidance for designing and operating integrity gates around human decision writes — any governed record where a named human decision changes state: approvals, ticket transitions, ADR acceptances, waivers, sign-offs, state transitions. Covers the HARD BLOCK / ACK / DISPLAY enforcement taxonomy, off|shadow|enforce staged rollout, server-recomputed snapshot-hash propose-then-confirm flow (409 on stale), deterministic script-aware rationale substance checks, maker/checker countersign with deny-by-default grants, and AI-recommendation divergence recording. Use when: designing or reviewing a decision-write gate, planning a gate rollout, hardening an approval path, or making human decisions auditable.
